claims.head: Zegras gets company tonight
claims.call: The Capitals’ L2 (Protas, Jenner and Wilson) spends at least 60% of its 5-on-5 time against the Flyers’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Capitals keep sending Wilson’s line (Protas, Jenner and Wilson) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Spencer Carbery has been giving this group the hard job of facing the other team’s top line. Tonight the Flyers’ first line is Zegras, Dvorak and Acciari.

claims.gist: At home, Spencer Carbery likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Flyers’ first line.

claims.head: The Capitals hunt better looks than the Flyers
claims.body: The Capitals wait for good looks, but the Flyers settle for hopeful ones. Washington is the league’s best for shot quality, and Philadelphia is near the bottom. The more dangerous chances should be the Capitals’.
